AKITA CITY
PHYSICAL TRAINING FACILITY
Akita City, Japan
Akita City
July 2018 Edition
Akita
1 hour
Tokyo
Akita Prefecture, rich in nature, is located in northwestern Japan. Her
capital, Akita City, is about a one hour flight from Tokyo. However, due to its
shorter rainy season, Akita is comparatively less susceptible to typhoons. The
city’s relatively cooler climate allows for a much easier recovery from jetlag,
and thus also a smoother adjustment for one’s physical condition.
Yabase Sports Park, which includes various physical training facilities, is
conveniently located in central Akita, about 10 min. by car from JR Akita Sta￾tion. Its training ground, surrounded by lush greenery, also offers a suitable
environment for relaxing one’s mind and body.
Besides its convenient location, cool climate, and substantial number of fa￾cilities, Akita’s training grounds provide athletes with an optimal environment
in which to improve their performance.
Come to Akita, and enhance your athletes’
performance at our pre-training camps in preparation
for various world events, including the upcoming
Tokyo Olympic and Paralympic Games!

Akigin Stadium (Yabase Sports Park Field)
1-1 Yabase Undo Koen, Akita-shi, Akita TEL: 018-883-1870 FAX: 018-883-1871

Facility Information
Located inside Yabase Sports Park in central Akita, this outdoor sports facility is used for multiple types of ball
games, mainly soccer and rugby.
Also the home ground of the Akita Northern Bullets (Akita’s Top East League Division I rugby team), Akigin
Stadium enables fans to feel close to the team due to the short distance between stands and the field.
The stadium is used as a venue for practices or other events, regardless of the time it takes place. It also has a
second field with artificial turf and Health Plaza, a common area featuring natural grass.
It is praised as one of the best outdoor grounds both for soccer and rugby.

The Yabase Sports Park Athletic Field has been the citizens’ sports ground since 1941. Located in central Akita,
the facility also hosted the 16th and 62nd National Athletic Meets and 2001 World Games Tournament. With run￾ning tracks both in and outside the field, it is a popular jogging spot for locals, regardless of age and gender. The
park has fostered many Akita-born athletes, ready to appear on the world stage.
The field is also the home ground of the Blaublitz Akita J-League soccer team and other non-track related
events, and is thus considered an essential hub for sports in Akita.

This indoor facility, the largest gymnasium in Tohoku, accommodates various sports events both on the do￾mestic and international level. Featuring architecture inspired by the Temple of Olympian Zeus, CNA Arena Akita

Game for one night.
Currently the home court for the B-League profession￾al basketball team, Akita Northern Happinets, the arena is
also scheduled to be the venue of the International Bad￾minton Competitions from 2018 through 2021.

The Yabase Sports Park Health Plaza is conveniently adjacent to the artificial turf-equipped Space Project
Dream Field, and is utilized in various ways. Featuring natural turf that lessens the impact on one’s body, it houses
many rugby and soccer matches. It is also used by local residents for various purposes, such as enjoying numerous
sports, promoting their health, and interacting with friends, as it is open to the public.
Space Project Dream Field, the second Sports Park field in Yabase Sports Park, was constructed in 2014. With
the aim of diminishing the physical impact on one’s body, it features laid artificial turf that greatly resembles
natural turf.
As it is located adjacent to Yabase Sports Park, the field is thus convenient for various activities.
Used mainly as a competition venue for rugby and soccer, it is also equipped with floodlights. This makes it a
popular place for locals, regardless of age or gender, to take part in and have sports exchange events.
